mapper.select: SELECT detail.id, detail.sport_info_id, detail.sport_type, detail.disease, detail.method, detail.notes, detail.image_url, sport_info.suitable_time, sport_info.suitable_heart_rate, sport_info.suitable_frequency, sport_info.recommended_speed FROM detail INNER JOIN sport_info ON detail.sport_info_id = sport_info.id WHERE detail.sport_type = #{sport_type}

SELECT detail.id, detail.sport_info_id, detail.sport_type, detail.disease, detail.method, detail.notes, detail.image_url, sport_info.suitable_time, sport_info.suitable_heart_rate, sport_info.suitable_frequency, sport_info.recommended_speed FROM detail LEFT JOIN sport_info ON detail.sport_info_id = sport_info.id WHERE detail.id = #{id}

SELECT detail.id, detail.sport_info_id, detail.sport_type, detail.disease, detail.method, detail.notes, detail.image_url, sport_info.suitable_time, sport_info.suitable_heart_rate, sport_info.suitable_frequency, sport_info.recommended_speed FROM detail LEFT JOIN sport_info ON detail.sport_info_id = sport_info.id WHERE detail.sport_info_id = #{sportInfoId} LIMIT 1
